description: Death and knockout sounds for players and enemy types

effects.name: Player Knockout
effects.prompt: Fantasy player knockout, heroic fall, body collapsing, defeated groan, dramatic but dignified, brief fade

effects.name: Beast Death
effects.prompt: Fantasy beast death, animal creature dying howl, wounded animal collapse, primal death cry, body thud

effects.name: Humanoid Death
effects.prompt: Fantasy humanoid death, enemy warrior fall, armor clanking on ground, defeated grunt, body collapse

effects.name: Undead Death
effects.prompt: Fantasy undead death, skeleton crumbling, bones scattering, unholy energy dissipating, ghostly wail fading

effects.name: Elemental Death
effects.prompt: Fantasy elemental death, magical energy dispersing, elemental form collapsing, crackling dissipation, essence fading

effects.name: Dragon Death
effects.prompt: Fantasy dragon death, massive creature roar fading, giant body crashing, earth-shaking thud, legendary beast falling

effects.name: Demon Death
effects.prompt: Fantasy demon death, hellish screech, dark energy imploding, infernal form banishing, evil essence destroyed

effects.name: Construct Death
effects.prompt: Fantasy construct death, golem crumbling, mechanical parts falling, stone or metal breaking apart, magical gears stopping

effects.name: Insect Death
effects.prompt: Fantasy giant insect death, chittering stopping abruptly, exoskeleton cracking, legs curling, squelching demise

effects.name: Plant Death
effects.prompt: Fantasy plant creature death, vines wilting, leaves rustling down, organic matter collapsing, natural decay sound
